newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TEENAGE DEBUTANT RAUL INCLUDED IN SPANISH SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEENAGE DEBUTANT RAUL INCLUDED IN SPANISH SQUAD.

text.p: Spanish manager Javier Clemente has included Real Madrid's teenage striker Raul Gonzalez in the squad to face the Czech Republic in the World Cup qualifying match on October 9.

With Spain likely to face problems in the air, two tall players -- Betis defender Roberto Rios and Athletic Bilbao frontman Ismael Urzaiz -- have also been called up for the first time. Rios is 1.92 metres tall and Urzaiz 1.88 m.
"There are some players absent ... it's the right moment to pick Raul," said Clemente on Monday.

Raul, 19, shot to prominence as a goalscorer two years ago, but has since been moved into a supporting role by new Real Madrid coach Fabio Capello. He set up all three Real Madrid goals in Sunday's 3-2 victory at Oviedo.
Clemente had been strongly criticised for sticking by veteran forward Julio Salinas instead of choosing Raul.

Neither Salinas nor injured striker Kiko Narvaez will make the trip, but Kiko's Atletico Madrid teammate Jose Luis Caminero is fit and is expected to be given the role of playmaker in the starting line-up.

Of seven players chosen from the multi-billion peseta Barcelona line-up, neither midfielder Guillermo Amor nor defender Abelardo Fernandez or striker Juan Pizzi have played regularly under Bobby Robson this season.
By contrast utility man Luis Enrique Martinez has blossomed since moving to the Nou Camp stadium from Real Madrid. Squad:
Goalkeepers - Andoni Zubizarreta (Valencia), Santiago Canizares (Real Madrid)

Defenders - Roberto Rios (Real Betis), Alberto Belsue (Zaragoza), Rafael Alkorta (Real Madrid), Fernando Hierro (Real Madrid), Miguel Angel Nadal (Barcelona), Agustin Aranzabal (Real Sociedad), Sergi Barjuan (Barcelona), Abelardo Fernandez (Barcelona)
Midfielders - Guillermo Amor (Barcelona), Josep Guardiola (Barcelona), Luis Enrique Martinez (Barcelona), Julen Guerrero (Athletic Bilbao), Jose Luis Caminero (Atletico Madrid)
Strikers - Juan Pizzi (Barcelona), Raul Gonzalez (Real Madrid) Alfonso Perez (Real Betis), Ismael Urzaiz (Athletic Bilbao)
